data.name: alpha-synuclein (SNCA)
data.description: Presynaptic protein whose misfolded aggregates form Lewy bodies in Parkinson's disease and related synucleinopathies. Cleared by autophagy and by chaperone-mediated autophagy. No study or pathway link in this Atlas supports a claim about mTOR and its clearance: the mTORC1-inhibition account rests on work outside this corpus, and chaperone-mediated autophagy is regulated by mTORC2/PHLPP1/Akt rather than by mTORC1 (ARI2015), so the two routes should not be merged.
data.description_beginner: A protein found in nerve endings that can misfold and clump together, forming the toxic 'Lewy bodies' seen in Parkinson's disease. The cell's cleanup systems normally clear it. This Atlas holds no study and no graded link about mTOR's role in that clearance, so nothing here should be read as settling it - and the two cleanup routes involved answer to different mTOR complexes.
